claims: SpaceX Falcon 9 launched 29 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station on March 17, 2026 at 9:27 a.m. EDT.
SpaceX Falcon 9 launched 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base on March 16, 2026.
SpaceX Falcon 9 launch on March 16, 2026 from Vandenberg Space Force Base marked over 10,000 satellites launched, according to Spaceflight Now.
Multiple additional Starlink missions are scheduled from Vandenberg Space Force Base in late March 2026.
The 12th test flight of the Starship vehicle is expected from Starbase, Texas in April 2026, notes RocketLaunch.org.
